steps.prompt: Use case: production game sprite atlas. Reference image is ONLY a material/rendering style reference. Match the realistic cratered irregular asteroid in ROW3 COLUMN1 of the reference, not its planets or suns. Generate a STRICT THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS square transparent sprite sheet containing EXACTLY TEN individual complete mining asteroids, the last TWO cells fully empty transparent. No spheres: irregular craggy rocky objects with angular facets, pits, believable granular minerals and subtle upper-left studio highlights. Each asteroid centered in its own cell, at most76 percent of the smaller cell dimension, generous fully transparent padding, at least20 clear pixels along every cell boundary; absolutely no neighboring overlap or edge clipping. ROW1 left-to-right:1 iron asteroid, brown-grey pitted metallic ore rock with silver flecks;2 prism asteroid, dark rock containing prominent pale violet-clear crystalline shards;3 ice-core asteroid, charcoal stony edge around pale icy-blue frost and exposed cyan ice. ROW2:4 magnetite asteroid, dark metallic iron rock mixed with violet mineral crystals, compact heavier angular shape;5 hydrate asteroid, grey-brown ore rock with cyan-blue frozen water fissures;6 clathrate asteroid, pale blue-violet crystalline icy rock with enclosed softly amber gas pockets. ROW3:7 pitchblende asteroid, mostly dark brown iron rock with sparse subtle warm-pink antimatter mineral veins;8 resonance asteroid, violet-clear crystal rock with sparse rose-pink energy inclusions;9 comet-core asteroid, irregular dark-blue ice-and-rock kernel with tiny pale-pink inclusions, NO comet tail. ROW4:10 primordial-matter asteroid only in LEFT cell: dark warm golden-brown #8a5f1c rough stone split by bright pale-gold #ffe6ab mineral veins, clearly recognizably GOLD and visually distinct from the nine ordinary ores. Row4 middle/right entirely empty alpha. These are ten resource classifications, no extra props or fantasy creatures. Strong visible differentiation of rock texture, ice, crystalline matter and GOLD primordial matter, consistent art finish across all ten. TRUE transparent alpha background, no black rectangles, space backdrop, bases, shadows cast on a floor, labels, names, numerals, grid, dividing lines or frames. Fine crisp surface detail, no depth-of-field blur, bloom or haze. Target4096x4096 if supported; retain whole artboard.
